rule: implementation_use = ALLOWED (the only state that sets implementation_allowed = true in AIRCRAFT_NUMERIC_FIELD_INDEX.json) requires: the source's own content inspected by the library at PAGE_VERIFIED, the configuration known, units and convention known, and the page/table/figure recorded. Values read only in other Maverick documents carry exactness REPOSITORY_READING and verification_level SEARCH_LEAD_ONLY: the repository reading is recorded in existing_maverick_analysis, it is not a primary source.

configurations.label: Production F/A-18A/B (U.S. Navy)
configurations.fcs: Production digital FBW (PROM versions V8.x/V10.x family); production gains NOT public
configurations.notes: Target identity for 'baseline F/A-18' claims. No public source in r0 provides production FCS gains or a manufacturer aero database.

configurations.label: NASA HARV Phase 1 — basic F-18 hardware/software configuration
configurations.airframe: F-18 full-scale development aircraft #6 (pre-production; built before the F/A-18 redesignation)
configurations.fcs: Basic F-18 FCS (V8.3.3 per VDD; upgrade to V10.1 timing unverified)
configurations.research_hardware: Spin chute (why the Navy loaned this airframe), research instrumentation; no TV vanes
configurations.notes: Flight-derived lat-dir derivatives for this configuration: NASA-TM-4786. Mass properties: NASA-TM-4772 Phase 1 column.

configurations.label: NASA HARV Phase 2 — multi-axis thrust vectoring + RFCS
configurations.engine: F404-GE-400 x2 with 3 external TV vanes per engine
configurations.fcs: Basic F/A-18 FCS (V10.1 family) + RFCS (Pace 1750A, Ada) running NASA research laws (e.g., NASA-1A)
configurations.research_hardware: TV vane system (~2,200 lb); spin-chute / emergency-system / ballast changes (~1,500 lb)
configurations.notes: TV hardware changes mass (Phase 2/3 column of TM-4772) and aft-body aero; never merge TV terms into a baseline F/A-18.

configurations.label: NASA HARV Phase 3 — TV + Actuated Nose Strakes for Enhanced Rolling (ANSER)
configurations.fcs: RFCS running the ANSER research control law (NASA-TM-110217; v152.0 validated in NASA-CR-198250)
configurations.research_hardware: TV vanes + conformal actuated forebody strakes
configurations.dates: ANSER flight data July 1995 - May 1996; program ended September 1996
configurations.notes: Only configuration with a public, code-level control-law specification.

configurations.label: NASA Langley 'f18bas' simulation (NASA-TM-107601)
configurations.notes: Wind-tunnel-derived database, alpha -10..+90 deg, beta -20..+20 deg, table look-up with linear interpolation (extract).

configurations.label: NASA Langley 'f18harv' simulation (NASA-TM-110216)
configurations.engine: F404 engine model with TV effects (details unverified)
configurations.fcs: Host for NASA-1A / lateral-directional / ANSER research laws
configurations.notes: Database domain per extract: alpha -10..+90 deg, beta -20..+20 deg, Mach 0..2.0. Domain is not a validated envelope.

configurations.label: NASA F/A-18 Systems Research Aircraft
configurations.research_hardware: EPAD EHA/EMA on left aileron; fly-by-light; power-by-wire
configurations.notes: Useful for actuator technology only; no aero model located.

configurations.label: NASA F/A-18A Active Aeroelastic Wing (X-53)
configurations.airframe: Navy F/A-18A airframe 853 with wings taken from HARV 840, wing-box skins thinned
configurations.dates: Program from 1996; flight phases early 2003 and early 2005
configurations.notes: Serial-identity trap: HARV 840's wings flew again on 853 in a different structural configuration.

configurations.label: NASA Full-scale Advanced Systems Testbed (FAST) F/A-18
configurations.airframe: F/A-18 (tail number per program pages 853; unverified)
configurations.fcs: Nonlinear dynamic inversion baseline research law (2011)

configurations.label: University of Minnesota falling-leaf analysis model
configurations.fcs: Reconstructed baseline and revised F/A-18 control laws
configurations.notes: Built from 'F/A-18 HARV aerodynamic data in the open literature' (abstract) plus the Heller/David/Holmberg control-law description.

configurations.label: F/A-18E/F Super Hornet
configurations.notes: Not a variant of the HARV data set. Do not mix.

configurations.label: General Electric F404-GE-400 (engine identity)
configurations.airframe: Installations: F/A-18A/B (twin), HARV (twin with TV vanes), X-29A (single)
configurations.notes: Engine-level (uninstalled) data from X-29A tests may inform the engine; installed effects do not transfer between airframes.

configurations.label: 1/10-scale F-18 rotary-balance model (Langley Spin Tunnel; NASA CR-3608)
configurations.notes: Component build-up (body, wing, LEX, tails) preserved by the repository transcription; scale-model data never full-scale exact.
